item.title: Comically chaotic chat with no boundaries: best podcasts of the week
item.summary: Fern Brady and Alison Spittle return for natter with no rules. Plus, the viral red phone is back on the bridge Comedians Fern Brady and Alison Spittle return for a second series of comically chaotic chat. Expect plenty of wildly pinballing discussions with no theme other than what pops into their heads. Topics so far include Robert De Niro’s much younger partner, podcasts about nuns playing ultimate frisbee – and Brady on how “so many of Bonnie Blue’s views are so close to mine”. Business as usual, then. Alexi Duggins Widely available, episodes weekly Continue reading...
